segments.contextAfter: The state machine notifies the current state whenever a state change happens. Use the [`didEnter(from:)`](gkstate/didenter(from:).md) and [`willExit(to:)`](gkstate/willexit(to:).md) methods to perform actions in response to a state change. For example, an enemy character entering the Flee state might change its appearance to indicate that is has become vulnerable to attack by the player.

segments.contextAfter: When you call a state machine’s [`update(deltaTime:)`](gkstatemachine/update(deltatime:).md) method, the state machine calls the [`update(deltaTime:)`](gkstate/update(deltatime:).md) method of its current state. Use this method to organize per-frame update code by state. For example, an enemy character in the Chase state can update its position to pursue the player, and an enemy in the Flee state can update its position to evade the player.
